title: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

sense.text:
Before anything else, strong has to be defined, because the definition of strong is wrong according to God. The black woman who professes to be a strong black woman hates God and does not believe this Bible: she has her identity from America, and America is Babylon in the Bible, the place God is going to destroy. So her strength is temporary. The strength of the true daughters of Sarah, the women of God, is eternal, and their strength is the wisdom they have of God.

“Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land.” That is how you get strength: by keeping God’s commandments. The most powerful force known to mankind is God, not the United States of America. America is only here because God set them up to be king now. They are the last empire: Daniel spoke of four empires, the Babylonians, the Persians and the Medes, and the Greco-Roman Empire, and America is an extension of ancient Rome. Their kingdom is temporary, and the Bible says they are going to be destroyed. God gave the instructions of what we are supposed to do before the destruction.

“And that ye may prolong your days in the land”: keeping the commandments prolongs your days. Israel had just been delivered from Egypt, and God was giving them instructions.

“A land that floweth with milk and honey.” That is why our people like America: they say it has all the resources. But God is the one that gave the resources. America has milk and honey and iPhones and cars because they enslaved you, negro. They used our people for hundreds of years of free labor and altered our behavior, so now you think America is your savior.

“For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt.” Egypt was destroyed by God, and he was telling Israel, I have something better for you than Egypt. “Where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot”: we were sowing seed in Egypt and taking care of Egypt with our feet.

It is the same with America. You think America is good because you are in slavery here and they give you certain benefits. God has something better than America: the twelve tribes of Israel coming together according to prophecy to set up the kingdom of heaven on earth.

God has a land that he says his eyes are upon: “the eyes of the Lord thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.” God has his eyes always on a specific place for us.

“If ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day.” This is why people call us legalists, saying our ministry tells people to keep the commandments. This is why: God brought us into covenant on the keeping of them.

The rain of the land produces agriculture so that we can eat. We have no control over that now. America raises the gas prices; they have the food plantations and the food plants. God had it set up so that we control the land, and that is how we stand. Now you are being fed by another man, and he controls how you eat. God told us, I am going to send rain, you are going to have your own land, your own crops, your own cattle, and you are going to live good, not in debt to another nation to sustain you. As the Bishop brought out, they control the Caribbean and all the islands by taking their resources and making them indebted.

“That thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.” That is what our people worry about: what we are going to eat. No matter how bad society breaks down, if you have your own land you do not pay rent; if God gives you rain and you have your own crops, your own cattle and your own eggs, why care about the things America worries about? America set us up to be dependent on them, and did it to all the other countries they destabilized, because that is the only way they can stay in power: by taking down leaders and taking control of the people. That is how they are able to devour.

“That thou mayest eat and be full.” That is what sustains us: not McDonald’s, not Burger King, not Wendy’s, not these fast food restaurants. Look how far we have fallen: we are being fed by the beast, nourished for a time, and everything is wrong in our life.

“Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived”, and we did get deceived. “And ye turn aside, and serve other gods”, and we serve other gods: Methodist, Baptist, Catholic, Jehovah’s Witness, Seventh Day Adventist, Protestant, Lutheran, Pentecostal. These are all false gods. When they took us as slaves they trained us how to behave. They stopped us from reading and writing, then taught us the Bible the way they felt would benefit them. They created a slave Bible, gave us slave religions to follow, and made obedient slaves out of us, because they know our people have a zeal of God but not according to knowledge. These people studied us to destroy us, so we believe everything but what the Bible says and what Christ says.

White people made that stuff up. This is not church; it has nothing to do with God; it is all lies, with the white man Jesus on top. Nowhere in the Bible is there a white Jesus. They made him up during the Renaissance: Pope Alexander VI of Rome, Rodrigo Borgia, sanctioned his son Cesare Borgia to pose for that white image, they called him Salvatore and told us he is our savior. That is how they modified our behavior, by telling us a white man is our savior, so we deny the God and the life he gave us. The brothers traveling the earth find that the hardest thing is telling our oppressed people that Jesus Christ is not a white man: in Africa they fight tooth and nail for the white Jesus the Roman Catholic Church gave them, and in Jamaica it is Haile Selassie foolishness.

precepts.why:
God’s eyes are upon this land too, but for a different reason: “Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth.” America is a sinful kingdom, and God is looking at America to destroy it.

“Saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob.” Jacob is the father of the twelve tribes of Israel. “I will sift the house of Israel among all nations”, because we were scattered all over the earth in slavery, so he is going to sift us out of every place where we went into captivity, “like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.” The sifting is a teaching process. That is why the Bishop gave the order: go where our people were slaves historically and train them how to behave for God, to establish the kingdom, because they have been trained after the ways of the colonizers, their oppressors and enslavers. So we have to train them in the word of God to establish the house of Israel.

“All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword”: that is our people who are rebellious to what God has to say and want to do things their own way, “which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.” That is what America, aka Egypt, has convinced our people to believe: nothing can happen to you here. Donald Trump talks about the strongest military, his top fighter jets, blowing the Strait of Hormuz open and blowing people back to kingdom come. Stop believing that because this man talks tough and proud, you cannot be touched.

So there are two lands under God’s eye: the land he careth for, that he keeps for Israel, and the sinful kingdom he watches so that he can destroy it.

“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations.” Christians read this another way, but this is what it means: we were scattered into all nations, so we have to be taught in all nations. That is the same sifting among all nations in Amos 9: God sifts Israel out of the nations by teaching them, which is why the men are sent to the four corners of the earth where our people were taken as slaves.

Christ did not say go be a Methodist, Baptist, Catholic, Jehovah’s Witness, Seventh-day Adventist, Protestant or Lutheran. If you say you believe on Jesus Christ, this is what he said: “These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them.” Christ started his own ministry. He did not join with the church when he walked the earth; he was against the church and condemned them. If you are a true follower of Christ, this is what you should be doing.

“Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not.” That is why he gave the parable of the good Samaritan: there were northern kingdom Israelites in Samaria. “But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” Why are we lost? Because we broke covenant. When Christ came, it was to gather all twelve tribes back. People ask why we say we are the Israelites: because nobody else is declaring it. White people are not identifying our people as the Israelites, not letting them into their churches, not teaching them the commandments, not making life better for them with the word of God. If they want to say they are the people of the book, knock yourself out; leave us alone while we do what the Bible says.

“And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.” That is God’s plan for the Israelite man, and the only way we will stand: telling our people, you are not black, Hispanic, West Indian, Haitian, Caribbean or African; you are the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Anyone teaching anything else is a liar.

So in Deuteronomy 11 God brought Israel into a covenant: you will have the land for yourself, I will send you rain, it will be for your cattle and to sustain your family; all you have to do is keep my commandments. But we broke the commandments.

sense.text: This is when God brought us into covenant. “The Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth”: God wanted the twelve tribes of Israel to be the nation above all nations of the earth. First they had to define their worth.

“Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.” Our people think the blessings in the city and the field are whatever white people give us. You have no cities and no fields; they could cut you off at any time. You are not living, you are surviving. But the blessings come “if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God.”
“The fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle”: our health, our finances, our food, the things we worry about.
“Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store”: our finances.
“Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in”, when we are born, “and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out”, when we leave the earth. But we did not listen; we broke the covenant.

These are the consequences for breaking the covenant. “If thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God”: we did not listen; we did not want to follow his voice. “To observe to do all his commandments and his statutes”: that is the stipulation. Keeping God’s laws, statutes and commandments is how you become an organized nation. When God brought us into this covenant we ruled as a theocracy, theo meaning God: government by God. God say it, we obey it. Not the Constitution of the United States of America; we had a constitution with God.

“That all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.” For our disobedience we are cursed, cursed, cursed. If we do not put God first, we get cursed.

“Cursed shalt thou be in the city”: that is why our cities have drugs, violence, alcoholism, domestic violence, police brutality, gangbanging and mental illness, with the rents going up and our salaries staying down.

“And cursed shalt thou be in the field.” We own no more fields; they took them from us. When we were in the fields we were picking cotton, sugarcane and tobacco. They sent us into mines in Africa and cut off our hands and fingers when we did not meet the quota. They massacred the Native American Indians that were here before and broke all the treaties with them. Nothing has changed. The only thing that has changed is that when we tell our people what the Bible says, they look at it strange. This was said to our people before.

“Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her.” They raped our wives, our women and our daughters in captivity, and we could do nothing. They brought us here in chains, and they made movies about it: in the opening scene of The Butler a little boy is in the field with his father when a white man takes his mother into the barn; the father tries to intervene and gets a bullet in his head. That is why black women look at us now as weak: the historical damage done to us is generational and does not go away. We got no counseling for it and no reparations. Deacon Malachi said, to hell with reparations: just allow us to become the Israelite nation and keep your reparations. That is how we get our salvation.

“Thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein”: that is 12 Years a Slave, a man who won his freedom, was re-enslaved, and was made to build a house he could not come into. “Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof”: you had to meet a quota with an overseer over you, beaten violently if you fell short, and could not take grapes home for your family.

Sit with your children and watch 12 Years a Slave, Amistad and Roots. Turn off the Love & Hip Hop and the stupid shows, and show them their history so the Bible won’t be a mystery. This is your life and your book; they trained you not to look inside your book.

“Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof.” That is how oxtail became a delicacy: they kept the best meat for themselves and discarded the tail of the ox, and the slaves took it and seasoned it up. They gave us slop, food they fed to animals; in Farewell Uncle Tom they had us eating out of a trough like animals. Now our people fight over the tail of an ox at twenty dollars a plate, and IHOP is testing braised oxtail on a menu in five Bronx locations: oxtail omelets, oxtail tacos, oxtail quesadillas. They study us.

“Thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee.” That is why, when we ask for reparations, we say, where is our forty acres and our mule, or our ass? It was never restored unto us. This is your book; they just trained you not to look.

“Thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies”: sheepskin is a multi-billion dollar industry. “And thou shalt have none to rescue them”: to this day they are still robbing us and manipulating the system so that they stay on top and we stay on the bottom, and nobody says stop. It is not an equal playing field. That is why we need God: they are not going to give things back to us.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long.” Imagine the psychological trauma when your children are taken from you at birth, some never even held, handed off to another slave plantation. How can anyone read this book and say it is for white people? For you to read this and say it is white people, you hate God; that is the only answer. They have no history of this happening to them. And to the northern kingdom who think it is not them: they are separating your children as we speak and sending them off.

“And there shall be no might in thine hand.” That is why we need God. There is no might in our hand to stand, so we have to rise up as the Israelite man according to God’s plan. That is the only way we are going to stand.

“The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.” That is the prophecy. They came out of caves, made us slaves, and trained us how to behave. They brought us down very low. So we expect nothing from them but to do what God said in prophecy they were going to do. We are not asking them for anything; we are waiting patiently, as God says, for him to bring forth change.

“He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him.” There is no place where black people are lending white people money. Anything white people want from you, they take, and you cannot say anything; you say, yes, Mr. white man, come into our countries and take what you want. “He shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.”

“Moreover all these curses”: some of our people believe that because they have a good job, a nice house and a car, they are not cursed. You are the people that do not put God first, and you believe in a fake feel-good religion they gave you to sustain you. “Till thou be destroyed”: that is what we are, a destroyed people.

“Because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” The people in the church now are not listening to the voice of the Lord thy God. They go to a fake place on Sunday to feel good with the fake God they serve: Christian, Methodist, Baptist, Catholic, Jehovah’s Witness, Seventh-day Adventist, Protestant, Lutheran, Pentecostal, Mormon, evangelical, apologist. They are not following God; they are following something fake that was given to them as slaves to train them how to behave. “To keep his commandments and his statutes”: that is what the whole Bible is about. God gave us instructions to prevent our destruction.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign.” If you want to know who the Israelites are, God said these bad things, the loss of your land, heritage, culture, identity and resources, will be upon you for a sign. Read your Bible and see who this fits. “And for a wonder”: you have to wonder what is going on in this book, and why there are certain places they do not want us to look. “And upon thy seed for ever”: we always say we want better for our children, as our parents said before us, but this is upon our seed for ever.
“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things.” God would give us everything if we served him the right way.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies.” The nations ruling over us are our enemies. It is not because we do not like them; we never train anyone to dislike a race or ethnic group. We tell you, pay no attention to them and stay in your Bible. These conditions exist because we resist the word of God, and God said he is going to deal with them.

“In hunger”: that is why to eat we have to go to them. “And in thirst”: they could cut off our water supply at any time, or contaminate it like they did in Flint, Michigan. “And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” When were yokes of iron put on the necks of the Caucasian people who say they are the people of the book? It is our people who lost their land, heritage, culture and identity, who are destroyed and need a savior. The Messiah is the savior of the Israelites, and that is why they changed him from a black man to a white man, to execute their plan. Everything has been altered; we have been lied to, programmed and manipulated.

“As swift as the eagle flieth”: what is the symbol of the United States of America? The eagle is on the back of the dollar bill and the back of the quarter; when they landed on the moon they said, the eagle has landed; the eagle is on their military. God is making it plain.

“A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand”: that is why they forced us to speak English. The New Testament is written in Greek because the Caucasians that enslaved us first, under Alexander the Greek, forced us to speak Greek. When Paul says there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek, he is talking to us. For three hundred years before Christ came we stopped speaking our Hebrew and spoke Greek, under the Greco-Roman empire.
“A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young.” They do not care if you are young or old; they want to control your soul.

David was about to die, so he gave instructions to Solomon his son, who was going to be the next king. “Be thou strong therefore.” How do we define strong? “And shew thyself a man”: show yourself a man according to God’s plan.

“And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies.” That is the only way to identify someone that is strong. The black woman saying she is a strong black woman is not strong according to God; she is strong according to the devil. The devil took her to another level, and that is why she feels empowered and strong. Every time the Bible speaks about being strong, it is keeping God’s commandments, following his ways and doing what he says.

“As it is written in the law of Moses”: that is what we read in Deuteronomy 11. In the transfer of power from King David to his son, he said, follow what is written in the law of Moses. “That thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest”: that is how we prosper, when we keep God’s laws.

“If thy children take heed to their way”: that is what we are trying to teach our people today, to take heed to God’s ways. “To walk before me in truth”: America is fake. Everything America and all the other lands of our captivity set up is fake; they do not follow God or care about God. They are prospering because you are not, and as long as they have you in their power, they will continue to devour. They know what our people do not know: a time is coming when God will deliver his people. So our people keep looking to them for help, but if I were them I would not help either; I would have a MAGA hat on. That is what they are supposed to do.

“There shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.” The throne is how we rule. That is why they destroy our leaders and get rid of our teachers: they know that once men are teaching this, a kingdom is being established. That is why they reprogram our black women to feel empowered and strong, so they can do everything wrong.

America is doing the same thing that was done to Eve in the garden. This is a parable: when the Lord says beast, the scriptures show that men are beasts. “Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?” God had given Eve instructions.

Just as God told the Israelites, this is what sustains you, he told Adam and Eve, this is what sustains you; these are the do’s and don’ts: “Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.”

“Ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.” How was Satan able to deceive? He promised her a god-like level. She did not need anything: she was in paradise and her husband was a god. But there is something inside of women that Satan saw, where you can take control of their emotions and pull them away from God’s devotion, and when they fight for a level of power, all they use it for is to devour.

That is why Satan targeted Eve: that is how you disrupt the balance of life. You tell women they can be stronger than what God designed them to be and pull them out of their God-given divine nature. That is how you start a war: take women out of their God-given divine nature and write checks to them that you cannot cash. America is doing the same thing, and the women following it are following Satan today.

“As for my people, children are their oppressors.” Little monsters are terrorizing the communities. The places we do not want to live are that way because of wicked children in the streets with guns and violence, selling drugs and acting like thugs. The children respect nobody; they will kill you, fight you, attack you.

“And women rule over them.” Women want to be in a position of power; they want full control. That is why the court system, the legal system and the benefits are designed for them, and that is what makes them feel empowered: now I am a strong black woman, I am stronger than you.

“O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err.” God is supposed to lead us, but a system is leading us now. That system started with Adam and Eve in the garden: he took Eve out of her God-given divine nature and turned her against God, against her husband and against the nation of Israel. That is where the problem started. So now, through God’s teaching, we have to bring our women back, because they have already been programmed to attack, and a lot of them do not want to come back.

This is the scripture that inspired the class. Every day except the Sabbath the brothers are live on Clubhouse in the room Biblical Smoke, and after noon in Upload God’s Laws, with the rebroadcast on the YouTube page Israelite Social and a Spanish room, La Biblia en Fuego. Because it is open to the public, women come into the room very disrespectful, and these are Christian women: washed in the blood of Jesus, born again and saved, but they do not know how to behave. “Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection”, and all they want to do is argue and be disrespectful and combative.

“But I suffer not a woman to teach”: they want to be in a position of authority to teach. “Nor to usurp authority over the man”: they have no respect for the man; they are following Satan’s plan, because America told them to be strong, black, independent women.
“For Adam was first formed, then Eve.” He took it all the way back to the beginning of the Bible: the reason for the woman to be silent is that there is order with God.

“And Adam was not deceived.” Satan did not go to Adam to get them kicked out of the garden. “But the woman being deceived was in the transgression.” Why did she get deceived? Because she did not believe God was enough for her, and Satan was able to manipulate her out of paradise.

America is doing the same thing today. America has empowered the woman, and that is why black women say, I am a strong independent black woman and I don’t need no man. That is not according to God’s plan. That woman is working with the devil so he can take her to another level. She is not strong; she is dead wrong, and she will find out when it is time to die.

“Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing”: we cannot do it without our woman. “If they continue”: a lot of women are not going to continue. They are going to be what America trained them to be, the enemy of God, hating the Bible and hating God. Go to a black church on Sunday and the majority are women, emotional women, not following the instructions God gave to save.

“In faith”: they have no faith to follow what God says and do things his way. “And charity”: they are not charitable. “And holiness”: they display none of the attributes the Bible calls holiness. “With sobriety”: in your right mind. The strong independent woman is not in her right mind; she is Satan’s design.

precepts.why:
God is about to destroy this place: “Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth.” Destruction is coming here, and the strong, independent black woman is going to die, because she does not want to listen to what God has to say; she wants to do things Satan’s way.

She does not believe this, because she is Christian, Methodist, Baptist, and in those churches they tell her everything is going to be all right: turn to your neighbor and say God is good all the time, and sing all those songs. That is not according to the Bible. That is how people manipulate and deceive the woman, as Eve was deceived: they play on her emotions to pull her away from God’s devotion. She is supposed to be devoted to what God has to say, not doing things her own way.

sense.text: “Let your women keep silence in the churches.” Try to tell black women they should not be teaching in the church, show them this, and they will find every excuse to say they can. “For it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience.” The woman preaching in the church is disobedient, because America has created her to be a strong black woman with a big mouth. “As also saith the law”: it is in the law. We do not say this because we do not like you; we say it because it is written in God’s law.

“Let them ask their husbands at home”: she is supposed to have a husband, but she does not have a husband to ask, because she is a strong independent black woman. “For it is a shame for women to speak in the church”: but she is not ashamed; she does not care about this Bible, and to her it is a game. Being quiet, shown in two places, is for her protection.

In Harlem a fifteen-year-old girl who had been going back and forth with a boy at her school refused to give him her number, and he stomped her out on the street. Teach the girls: walk away when men are being disrespectful to you; come tell your father or another male; do not be up in a man’s face, do not raise your voice, do not go back and forth. This is how men are, and a woman is not stronger than a man. What the Lord says about the woman keeping silent in the church holds in society too.

This is the problem: a young woman tearing up a McDonald’s with her friends and filming the carnage for Instagram, afraid of nothing, worried about no consequences. That is the strong black independent woman America has made, and this is where it starts. And a woman who shot a man at a gas station, then went live: you have no authority on my earth, I am the most high God, the creator of this matrix, my husband Jesus is here. That is your strong, black, Christian, independent woman, a woman who reads the Bible and quotes scripture, and she would have shot any one of us. This is how far we have fallen, because the women do not listen to God when he is calling.

“Because the daughters of Zion are haughty”: haughty means mean, nasty. This was before America was established: God looked at the woman and said, you are nasty, like the nasty spirit seen in those women. “And walk with stretched forth necks”: you cannot tell them anything; they do not want to hear anything.

“And wanton eyes”: the woman is supposed to be shamefaced, but their eyes are in everybody’s face. A woman who is not demure, ready to stare you down: walk away from her; that is an evil woman. Train your daughters not to make eye contact with people and not to be in people’s faces, and if that spirit is on them, take it off them.
“In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments.” Whatever they put on that makes them feel empowered, the Lord said he would take away when they went into captivity.

Our women like to get dressed up and look good: the ornaments, the chains and the bracelets, “changeable suits of apparel”. God said, I am going to take that away from you when you are taken as slaves.

“Instead of sweet smell there shall be stink”: they would smell bad when the captivity happened. “And instead of a girdle a rent”: their figures would be disfigured. “And instead of well set hair baldness”: that is why our women are so obsessed with their hair now, and the Koreans have made it a multi-billion dollar industry.

That is why there is so much cosmetic surgery, BBLs and mommy makeovers, women going to Brazil for butt lifts and face lifts. Believe it or not, the women did not break down the way they are breaking down now; the Lord took care of us. God is showing the woman where she went wrong, when she decided that she is the one who is strong.

“Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.” We usually stop before this, but on top of bringing the women down low, he said, your men are going to pay. The other nations enslaved us, changed us and renamed us with the sword, so now the black woman looks at the black man as weak, inferior, a nobody. That is why we have to train our women to look at the men through God’s eyes: once we show them in the scripture and paint the picture, they will look at this world and their existence differently.

We were mighty and we did fight for our city. People attack us in the street and on Clubhouse: y’all ain’t got nothing but that Bible. We have God, which is better than all the things they temporarily have, and these things will be restored to us. But God cannot take us where we are going if we do not know where we came from.

The women are not strong by themselves. Eve was great in the garden because Adam was mighty; she was the one that created the condition for an eviction. God is addressing the attitude of the strong independent black woman who does not need anybody: he strips her of everything and then says, I am going to get your man also. That is why these conditions exist. This can only be taught to a woman who believes what is written; the black Christian women believe in the white man Jesus they were given. We follow the prophecy, not religiosity. Our people have been indoctrinated with religiosity and do not look at prophecy, and prophecy is what opens our eyes: the only way we will rise and return to the Most High.

The Bible speaks about wicked women and how hard they made it for the nation of Israel. Elisha sent one of the children of the prophets: when you get to Ramoth-gilead, find Jehu, “make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber”, pull him away from his brothers. Pour the oil on his head and say, “Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel.” Then run: “Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.”
“I have anointed thee king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.” God sent the young prophet to make Jehu the new king, because the king that was there was wicked.

“And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master.” This is how God works: he sent a prophet to say, I am anointing you king, but the stipulation for you to be king is to go and destroy Ahab’s house, “that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.”

Jezebel, a strong black woman, was attacking God’s prophets, and God wanted her dead for not listening to what he said. So he set up a king who is gangster to give her the right answer from God, which was to kill her. That is why the prophet was told to anoint him and run. That is why a girl like the one in Harlem should be told: do not argue with men, because God will send crazy people around you and they will hurt you.
“For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall.” God wanted everybody from King Ahab’s house dead, and God sets men up to execute that.

“And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her.” God wanted Ahab’s wife Jezebel to die a horrific death and dogs to eat her. God is not with these emotions; God does not care that it is a woman. If you put yourself in the wrong position, God will take you out and send somebody who is on a mission. Then the prophet anointed him and ran, as Elisha told him.

“Wherefore came this mad fellow to thee?” Jehu’s men asked who that crazy man was, who pulled Jehu away, anointed him and ran. “It is false”: they said he was lying, because the prophet had not spoken to him in the presence of his men. Jehu was a captain, and the prophet pulled him to the side.
“And blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.” He has just been anointed; he tells his crew, and they blow the trumpet and announce him king.
Joram was the son of Ahab, and his mother was Jezebel. He was in Jezreel healing from the wounds the Syrians gave him, because he was at war with the Syrians.

They had their soldiers positioned, and the watchman saw Jehu, whom God had just made king, coming. Two horsemen were sent out to ask, “Is it peace?”, and neither came back: “turn thee behind me.” Then the watchman saw it: “he driveth furiously.” They are riding at us with fury.
Joram, Jezebel’s son, went out in his chariot to meet Jehu.

“What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?” There is no peace as long as you have a wicked woman in power. God set up Jehu to come and kill his mother and destroy their house because they put a wicked woman in power. That is what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God.

Joram tried to run in his chariot when Jehu told him there would be no peace as long as his mother was ruling: “There is treachery, O Ahaziah.” Jehu pulled the bow “with his full strength”, and the arrow went straight through his chest while he was fleeing.

This is when Jehu gets to the city. Jezebel hears he is there, “and she painted her face”. All she is thinking about is putting on makeup and fixing her face. Our women will not leave the house until they put that makeup on, and it was the same thousands of years ago: armies coming into the city, and all she cares about is putting on her face.

A lot of our sisters feel they need mad makeup and overdo it. You do not have to. Wicked women paint their face: that is what this scripture is showing us. Why did she paint her face? To entice the men, the foolish men, to be on her side for her beauty. But her beauty was superficial. Some women think that because men are attracted to them, the men like it, but a lot of men will not insult a woman because they want to get some. That look is not even feminine. Sisters, stop doing that; it is not attractive.
She was up in the tower with her guards. “Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.” The eunuchs were the security guards.

“Throw her down.” Throw her out of the window, if you are on my side. “And he trode her under foot”: after they threw her out of the window, he ran her over with the chariot. This is what they will never read in the Christian church. This was ordained by God for a strong, independent black woman, because she was evil: she was against the prophets, and she killed Naboth for his vineyard.

“And when he was come in, he did eat and drink”: after he killed her and ran her over, he sat down to eat like nothing happened, like a movie. Then: “Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.”

“They found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.” God had already said he wanted her to die a violent, horrific death. This is how God feels about women who interfere with the church and go against his instruction for the nation, and America is empowering a lot of women to go against what the scripture says and do their own thing.

“This is the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite.” This was ordained by God; Elijah had prophesied it. The Christian women do not believe in prophecy. Although this is history, there is prophecy concerning what God wants to happen to the rebellious, wicked, strong, independent black woman whom nobody can tell anything, ready to fight at the drop of a dime, with no respect for men or authority.

“And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field.” Dung is doo-doo: God wanted her body to be like doo-doo on the ground, thrown out of the window, splattered over the street, run over with a chariot, and the dogs to eat what was left. This is the God of the Bible they do not talk about in the Christian church. Why? Because she was attacking the men of God, the prophets of God.

When Jehu rolled up, what was Jezebel doing? Fixing up her face. A lot of women lead with that, not with God on their mind, only with how they look; she thought she was going to impress him. “So that they shall not say, This is Jezebel”: he wanted her unrecognizable.
Here is another wicked woman, who used the men around her to manipulate the people of Israel: “his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.”
“And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord.” She had a son who was evil just like the house of Ahab, the house that Jehu was told to destroy.

“And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.” This is a mother giving orders to kill anybody who is next in line, because her son died. It is different now, with America empowering the black woman, but back then a woman only had power through the man, through her son, as in the shows about bringing in a royal heir. Her only son in power was killed, so that was her decree.
They had to take the little boy, Joash, and hide him, because she would have killed him too. That is how wicked women are: to stay in power, they will start killing men.

“And he was with her hid in the house of the Lord six years.” For six years this woman was trying to hunt him down to kill him. “And Athaliah did reign over the land.” A woman was ruling who was not supposed to rule; the only reason she was in power is that she killed all the men, while this little boy was in hiding.

In the seventh year the priest made a covenant with the rulers and the captains and split them into three groups: “a third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house.”

“And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain.” They had to put bodyguards around the little boy and kill anybody who came near him.

“And they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.” That is where that saying comes from. We literally had to deal with a wicked woman trying to interfere with the rulership of men, so the priest had to see what the problem was and establish a king.

It is the same with our ministry: we are trying to set things up for the King of kings and Lord of lords, the black Messiah. America is trying to keep a white devil that was made up, called Jesus Christ, in power, and that is where black women get their power from: white Jesus. They do not want to get on board with the King of kings and Lord of lords, a black Messiah, because then they would have to go back to the God-given divine place God put them in. The strong independent black woman hates God.

“And Athaliah rent her clothes”: that is how mad she was that she lost power. “And cried, Treason, Treason.” She had just killed all the royal seed; the little boy they could not catch was anointed king, and she screams treason. When you try to restore order, that is how the black woman looks at it, as treason against her. Some are so far gone they do not see that they are out of order.
“And him that followeth her kill with the sword”: anybody that follows her, kill them. “Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord”: do not kill her in the house of God; take her somewhere else.

“And there was she slain.” That is the only way order was restored. Twice in the history, when black women rose up in power, all they wanted to do was devour, and God had to send men of the Lord to remove them out of the way for not listening to what God had to say. It is the same thing seen in that McDonald’s and with that woman with the gun: no care for order, no respect for any man.

Some women who want to serve the Lord are attached to wicked men; women keep coming into the Clubhouse saying, we listen to you, but our husband is wicked. This is when Nabal disrespected King David, and David was coming to kill him, and this is a woman married to a wicked man.

“Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial.” Belial means a child of Satan. She told King David openly, my husband is the devil, while a lot of women make excuses for the wicked men they are attached to. “Nabal is his name, and folly is with him”: he is a devil and he is stupid. She was not defending him. “But I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord”: I did not know he disrespected you.

“Now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.” Anybody trying to harm you, my lord, let them be as my wicked husband. We cannot tell women to leave their husbands; that is a decision they have to make. But the scripture paints the picture: not every woman that was with a wicked man took him by the hand and followed his plan.

“Because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.” She said, I know you fight for the nation of Israel; you are going to be a great man, and there is no evil in you.
“Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul.” She knew David was fighting to be king, and she told him, I know what is going on with you.

He was on the run and only stopped by Nabal to get food, and she tells him: you are going to overcome and be king, and “this shall be no grief unto thee”. I know you are mad at my wicked husband and he is a fool, but this is not even going to bother you. This is a woman who knows how to speak and how to deal with situations, because King David was coming to kill everything moving. “Then remember thine handmaid”: when God sets you up as king, remember me.
“And blessed be thy advice.” She was able to speak to him and bring his anger down. She knew she was attached to a wicked negro who was a dummy, but she met David, spoke to him, and calmed him.

The Lord put the spirit on her to speak to him, so she spoke eloquently and he changed his mind. That is why it is important for women to know how to speak and when to speak. “Except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.” If she had not come and calmed him down, he would have killed everybody; that is how mad David was.
She brought him food and drink, “and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house”.

“He held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king”: he did not want to give David any food, but he is feasting and throwing a party. “For he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.” She was not talking to him while he was drunk; she waited until he sobered up to let him know he almost got merked.

“His heart died within him, and he became as a stone.” Then “the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.” God killed him. There are two sides: the woman who is fully wicked, and the woman who gets the title of wicked because of who she is attached to. Here is a woman who got caught up with a fool but still moved wisely. We cannot tell a woman what to do; she has to read her Bible and make her decision, or when things go wrong she will say, IUIC said. Draw your strength from the scripture: let God paint the picture, and draw from the scripture.

“Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach.” Sometimes you have to let God handle your beef. Nabal was worthy of dying because he was wicked. “For the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head”, and the same with the SPLC: the Lord is going to return their wickedness on their own head, all the grief, the trials and tribulation, and the people lying on us. “And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife”: he did not forget; he remembered the advice she gave him.
“Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.” Even though she had been with a wicked idiot, she was still in a place of humility.
She took her servants, “five damsels of hers”, went after the messengers of David, “and became his wife”.

Some strong independent black women think that if they marry outside their race, life will be better: to hell with the black man, I am going to get me a white man. Some said, I want my child to have good hair, not nappy hair, not a nose like that; they hated everything about themselves. In the pictures of those who sold out and bragged about their white spouses, all the black spouses are dead and all the white spouses alive.

“Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons.” That is the law. “Nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong.” That is how you are strong: by staying within your own race. You are not strong because you go and mix with another race. When you stick with your own people you strengthen your race; when you sleep with another nation you weaken yourself and your race. When you race mix, God will not make you strong.

“And leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever”: you are supposed to have offspring so you can give the blessings God gave you to them, not to another race of people.
“For our evil deeds, and for our great trespass”: they were race mixing. “Thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve”: God did not really do to them what he wanted to do.

“Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations?” The strong black woman who says, I am going to get me a white man, has joined in affinity with the people of abominations. When you abandon your nation, that is an abomination. “Wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us”: God is angry with you when you abandon your nation and race mix, until you are consumed, and that is why those people on the screen are dead.
“For we cannot stand before thee because of this.” When you race mix, God will create bad conditions for you, and judgment will come your way.

This is what wise women are supposed to do: “Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.” Why does the foolish woman pluck it down? Because she does not listen to the wisdom, and the wisdom is according to the commandments. A foolish woman is going to use her own hands to find her own man and do her own thing; she will not listen to what the scriptures say.

precepts.why: “A gracious woman retaineth honour”: the honor God gave her. “And strong men retain riches.” The way strong men do things to keep their riches, a gracious woman will retain her honor, and her honor is dependent on her being obedient to God’s laws. That is the wise woman who builds her house.

“Forego not a wise and good woman”: when you have a woman who is wise according to the scriptures and good according to the scriptures, do not pass her up. “For her grace is above gold”: the grace God has bestowed on her as a woman of God is more valuable than gold.

“A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.”

Here is the woman that makes ashamed: a married woman who says, my marriage is not patriarchal, it is matriarchal; this is a girl’s world and my husband just lives in it. She says she hates men, she supports women decentering men, and she says being married was a flex. She is only married because she controls her husband. Only a simp would let a woman say that, and some men are married to strong, independent black women because they are weak and simp, and the women control how they think. The eyeball tattooed under her neck is the all-seeing eye of Ra, the eye on the dollar bill: that Egyptian mindset. This is America and ancient Egypt speaking from her mouth.

sense.text: The women the Bible describes here are gone. “Who can find a virtuous woman?” There are no more of them; it is these strong independent black women now. “For her price is far above rubies”: if you find a woman who matches what virtue is, value her.

“The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her.” The men who have women who want to keep these commandments have a value God says is far above rubies, so do not mistreat them. “So that he shall have no need of spoil”: he is not worried about the things of the world when he finds the right woman.
“She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.” Nobody wants to wake up to what was on that screen, a mean woman with an eyeball on her neck.
“She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.” She is not there for a payday, to live off the man, as that woman said being married was a flex.

“She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household.” She is concerned with being what God designed her to be: a good wife to her husband and a caretaker of the home. That is what we need to instill in our women and bring back.

Some women have no children and no husband, and people make them feel like they are nothing. This is what the Bible says: “Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue.” Remember, who can find a virtuous woman? You can be a woman with no kids and no husband and still have your virtue, meaning you are right in the eyes of God. Some women rush into a relationship, or see others in relationships and want to jump into one; some are single for a reason.

“For the memorial thereof is immortal”: nobody has anything bad to say about you, because you were not sleeping around and did not become a baby mom, and it is going to get you the kingdom. “Because it is known with God, and with men”: men are not saying you are promiscuous, and God sees that you are keeping yourself for him. You are following God’s plan, not having a baby just to have a baby, like the strong independent black woman who says, I don’t need no man for a kid. That does not make her strong; everything she is doing is dead wrong.

“When it is present, men take example at it”: they see you are not sleeping around; they see a woman of God. “And when it is gone, they desire it”: once you let the wrong man defile you, then you want it back. “It weareth a crown, and triumpheth for ever”: you are going to get eternal life when you do things right. “Having gotten the victory”: it is not bad to realize, I have not found the right person, so I am going to stay celibate and keep my virtue. “Striving for undefiled rewards”: the reward is the kingdom.

“But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive”: the women who say, I don’t need no man, with a whole bunch of kids and no man. Nothing good is going to happen for those kids. “Nor take deep rooting from bastard slips”, because they have no daddy, “nor lay any fast foundation”. They have no sure foundation in this world, because the mother wanted to be a strong independent woman and have kids with no father around, to show everybody, I can be the mommy and the daddy.

“They shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.” When life catches up to them, she will have to deal with their problems, because she decided to be a strong black woman and have kids out of wedlock out of hating men. The winds are life: when trials come, those kids are going to fall, because a sure foundation is a loving husband and a loving wife.

“The imperfect branches shall be broken off.” Why imperfect? Because the strong independent woman said, I don’t need no man, I can do it by myself. “Their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yea, meet for nothing”: the children brought forth that way, God says, are nothing.

“For children begotten of unlawful beds.” Why unlawful? Because she said, I don’t need no man, I’ll get pregnant and have the baby. Even in vitro fertilization is not of God; it is unlawful, taking strange semen, DNA from another man, without even caring where it came from, like the couple who took a white man’s DNA to make a baby and are now on the magazines as the happy family. That child goes against God; they believe the white man is their savior. Going to a sperm bank to create a child is not according to God, and such children are of no value in God’s eyes. They “are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial”: the mother is wicked.

Some of the sisters are single mothers, not by choice, or because they did not know the truth. This is not tearing them down; it was the strong independent black woman who says, I don’t need no man, I can raise these kids by myself, who was torn down. Now that you are in this truth, these are the instructions for a single mother who does not want her child to be a statistic.

“Be as a father unto the fatherless.” The men you meet in this truth are to be role models to your children who have no father of God, no man of God, in their life. That is how righteous men think. “And instead of an husband unto their mother”: they are not trying to get in your drawers because they see you with a child. “So shalt thou be as the son of the most High”: they care about the child as an Israelite child and are trying to set the example for him.

So the single mothers who come around here are to let the men groom their children to be successful serving God, so they will not be a statistic. Do not just think, I need to find a baby daddy; if it happens, fine, but that should not be the first thing on your mind. And the men are not to take advantage of the women who are single mothers.

Some strong black women think that because they are attractive they can use it to their advantage, but this is what the Bible says: “Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain.” In the world you may get favor because of your beauty, but it is deceitful, and your beauty is vanity because eventually you are going to get old. They post pictures on social media with everything out, and all they want is attention. “But a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised”, praised till the day she dies, because of her attributes of God. That is what is primary.

“Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning”: you do not lead with your looks. “Of plaiting the hair”: thinking that once your hair is done, your nails are done, everything is done, you will get things to your advantage. God said do not lead with that. Do not focus on your outward looks and your beauty, because favor is deceitful and beauty is vain. There is nothing wrong with looking nice, but do not lead with it.

Look at the women who have done plastic surgery after plastic surgery, Vivica Fox and Lil’ Kim: they look like science projects gone wrong. Favor is deceitful: they had favor in their beauty in their youth, but beauty is vain, because eventually you are going to get old.

“But let it be the hidden man of the heart.” That is what this ministry is for: to bring out the attributes of Christ. He is hidden in your heart, and that is where you need to start. “In that which is not corruptible”: nobody can say anything bad about that. When you bring that hidden man out, you are going to be immortal and get the kingdom. Even if your beauty fades, or you grow old in this truth, God is going to restore it to you. You cannot get that in the world as a strong, independent black woman; when it is gone, it is gone.

“Even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit.” That is what these classes are showing: there is power there. Your strength is in the wisdom of God and in having a meek and quiet spirit, not in tearing up a McDonald’s, pulling guns in a store and saying Jesus is your husband, or arguing with men in the street.

precepts.why:
We are not saying not to fix yourself up: “The beauty of a woman cheereth the countenance, and a man loveth nothing better.” That is why we encourage our women to look their best. Look your best, but do not lead with that; the primary thing to lead with is the hidden man of the heart. That is where you are supposed to start.

The beauty of a woman does cheer the countenance, but the stipulation is in verse 23: “If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue”. It is the way she talks to her husband; that is what makes the beauty stand out. “Then is not her husband like other men”: her husband is going to be happy, not sorrowful. He is not the brother sitting in the car for half an hour after work before he goes into the house, or at the bar because he does not want to come home.

So keep yourselves looking nice and take care of your bodies, but do not let America turn you into a science project. We watch the industry destroy our women, from Vivica Fox to Lil’ Kim to the rapper who put on fifty or sixty pounds and now endorses the big girls, while everybody tells them this is the standard of beauty. It is not.

sense.text: Some people will be mad that we pull these scriptures out and give these examples, but this is what God ordained us to do. “Set thy face against the daughters of thy people”: so we are not going to encourage anyone to be a strong independent black woman. “Which prophesy out of their own heart”: what they do is of their own heart, not of God. “And prophesy thou against them”: prophesy against what they are doing, because it is not of God.

“And say, Thus saith the Lord God”: tell them what God says about how a good wife is supposed to be, how a good marriage is supposed to be, how a woman is supposed to speak and why she is supposed to be silent. We are to show her what is written, if she is a woman of God. The women that are not of God will just be mad and in their feelings; this is to the women of God, to show you that you are in the right place to receive God’s grace.

“Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls!” They put their arm around you, they have the kerchief over their head, and all they are trying to do is hunt souls for their own goal. They are not trying to bring people to the Lord, and God said to prophesy against women like that. “Will ye hunt the souls of my people”: God does not want us to allow these evil, strong, independent women to hunt the souls of his people, so we have to point out their evil so they do not harm God’s people. “And will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?” Can they give them everlasting life, as the scripture says, once they get their attention?

“And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread”: that is what these women do. They pollute the teachings of God for their own reward and benefit, and do not set the standard with the scriptures. “To slay the souls that should not die”, because they set the wrong example and line other women up to get them killed. So we have to silence their voice with these scriptures and paint the right picture. “By your lying to my people that hear your lies”: everything about their life is a lie, which is why the examples have to be given.

“I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go.” How? With us teaching the right doctrine. Teaching the right doctrine frees our people from these evil women who set the example of what is strong, when everything they show is wrong.

“Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand.” How? God is going to raise up men who teach the scriptures the right way, and the people will listen to what God has to say. Satan raised up the woman in the garden, Eve, to turn against God and her husband; America raised up the black woman, empowering her to turn against God and her husband; but God says he is going to bring them back.

“And ye shall know that I am the Lord.” You are going to find out who God is when his men are raised up before you, teaching against the things America has taught you and against these lying religious denominations.
“I will make a man more precious than fine gold.” That is happening now: we have the scriptures in our soul, and that is how we become that fine gold.

“Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place.” After God makes these new men, and the scriptures speak of 144,000 new leaders, he is going to bring forth destruction to this earth. God is raising up new leaders now, and he cannot bring the destruction until he has made these new men more precious than fine gold.

“They shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.” That is what you are seeing now: a division of the races, and everybody going to their right places. As Israelites, we have to return to the Lord.
“Every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.” When this prophecy unfolds, make sure you are on the right side, or you will fall by the edge of the sword.
“Hear my voice, ye careless daughters.” God says the strong independent black women are careless, and they are not listening to God’s voice.

“Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women.” It looks like it is all good in the hood, but judgment is coming to this earth, and these women have to stop living carelessly. “For the vintage shall fail”: the time is coming. “The gathering shall not come”: what you look for in America is not going to come.

“Tremble, ye women that are at ease”: right now they are relaxed, thinking they won’t get taxed. “Strip you, and make you bare”: stop holding on to the way America made you, and take the word of God to save you; strip yourself down. “And gird sackcloth upon your loins”: humble yourself.
“Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers.” Things are going to go wrong for the women who think they are strong.
“Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high.” This is what is happening to us: God is pouring out his spirit upon us from on high.
“Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.” That is the purpose of our ministry.
